prompt: You volunteer at a community food bank where parcels are shared out equally by a fixed list. A friend who volunteers with you asks you to quietly set aside extra items for their own family, who are struggling at the moment. What is the most caring and fair response?

options.text: Follow the same list as everyone, explain you cannot set extras aside, and help your friend ask the coordinator about the proper routes for extra support for their family
Set the extras aside just this once, because their family's need is real and nobody will notice
Tell the coordinator what your friend asked, so the team knows to watch them
Give your friend your own volunteer meal and say nothing more about it

explanation: Bending the list would quietly take from other families waiting for the same parcels. Sticking to the shared rules while actively helping your friend find the official extra support treats both their need and everyone else's fairly.
